report.scope: PBI-009 'Waiting on you' panel: assessed the builder's 30 Python tests + 10 page checks against spec rev 3 (T-1..T-29, W-1..W-15, AC-75, AC-76) and filled one demonstrated gap - per-item (not per-session) owner-message clearing when an earlier and a later item of the same kind straddle one owner message; grounding: ran-suite (all three canonical commands, worktree C:/Users/jdk/dispatch-board-worktrees/PBI-009).
report.summary: 1 test file modified (tests/test_derive.py): 2 cases added (test_an_owner_message_clears_only_the_ask_before_it, test_an_owner_message_clears_only_the_refusal_before_it). tests/test_export_sessions.py and tests/page.test.mjs left unchanged - existing coverage (T-14..T-29) already maps cleanly to every spec requirement checked, including the 48h bound, the panel-level cap and drop order, the per-session cap of 5 with 'more', D2's idleness gate, and the panel ignoring the session filter. Suites: python -m unittest discover -s tests: 392 passed / 0 failed (was 390, +2 new, both pass on first run against the unmodified code - no defect surfaced); node tests/page.test.mjs: 131 passed / 0 failed (unchanged); python -m unittest discover -s local/tests: 304 passed / 0 failed (unchanged). Nothing committed, staged, or pushed; exporters/** and site/** untouched by this pass.

tests_authored.covers: Clearing rule (spec S7.1 rule 2, S7.3): a later owner message clears only items that occurred before it; an item of the same kind occurring after that owner message still lists. Untested branch of the shared later()/lastOwnerAt comparison - all existing clearing tests used exactly one item per session, so a session-wide 'owner ever spoke' bug would not have been caught.
